_comment: UFV campus model: metadata.planning_model and metadata.local_routing describe how this JSON feeds PDDL (macro) vs in-floor instructions (micro).

metadata.coverage: G (3 floors, all-to-all), CD (cafeteria, gym), H (minimal)
metadata.planning_model: PDDL is the sole reasoner: topology AND metric distances live in the building-specific problem files (see pddl/domain_G.pddl). campus_graph.json is only a display layer.
metadata.local_routing: local_connections: structured distance_m (meters, consumed by the PDDL converter) and hint (short directional text, consumed by the conversation agent for TTS decoration only).
